<details class="rwv-analysis-details">
<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

Draw the fixed 11-row KO heatmap, matching carrier-rank contributions, tool-specific defense/anti-defense sets and the ORF101-ORF103 candidate locus on vOTU0052 from verified 030 tables. KO values are carrier TPM sums transformed as log10(TPM+1), without row standardization.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
style <- rwv_style_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", manifest))
style <- rwv_style_for_figure(style, "fig3")   # v39: figure-specific text sizes (config/style.yml figure_text_pt)
samples <- rwv_samples_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest), style)
palettes <- rwv_palettes_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/palettes.yml", manifest))
figures <- rwv_figures_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/figures.yml", manifest))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
# Short display names of the Figure 3a rows (2026-10-14; Codex-reviewed candidate). KO stays the row identity.
ko_labels <- as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_project_input(step, "config/f3-ko-labels.tsv", manifest)))
up3 <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "030-function-inputs", f)))
disp <- up3("f3_display.tsv")
ranks <- up3("f3_carrier_ranks.tsv"); ranks$fraction <- as.numeric(ranks$fraction)
sets <- up3("defense_sets.tsv"); sets$n <- as.numeric(sets$n)
narp <- up3("narp_definitions.tsv")
locus <- up3("votu0052_locus.tsv")
catalogue <- as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "020-community-analysis", "checkv_catalogue.tsv")))
fonts <- rwv_fonts_resolve(style, italic = TRUE)   # gene symbols in panel a are italic
spec <- rwv_figure_spec(figures, "fig3", params$name)
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
pt <- style$text_pt; ink <- style$colours$text; fam <- style$font$family; col <- style$colours
lvl <- rwv_sample_levels(samples)
site_col <- rwv_site_colours(style)
```

### Task 2: Panel a: the fixed 11-row KO heatmap

```{r}
#| label: panel-a
rwv_check(checks, "11 displayed KOs in frozen order", c("K00558", "K13381", "K00820", "K01939", "K00560", "K01858", "K00390",
                                                       "K13010", "K06217", "K03462", "K13522"), disp$KO,
          source = "F3-display-selection.tsv (frozen list)")
# Rows are keyed by KO; the y-axis shows the short display name from config/f3-ko-labels.tsv
# (gene symbols italic, function names and abbreviations upright). Nothing is grouped by label.
lab_map <- ko_labels[match(disp$KO, ko_labels$KO), ]
rwv_check(checks, "label table covers the 11 displayed KOs, one row each", sort(disp$KO), sort(ko_labels$KO), source = "config/f3-ko-labels.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "short labels are non-empty and unique", 11L, length(unique(lab_map$short_label[nzchar(lab_map$short_label)])))
rwv_check(checks, "no short label needs truncation (<= 26 characters)", TRUE, all(nchar(lab_map$short_label) <= 26))
rwv_check(checks, "italic is used exactly for gene symbols", lab_map$label_type == "gene_symbol", toupper(lab_map$italic) == "TRUE")
disp$row_label <- disp$KO
row_levels <- rev(disp$row_label)
ko_short <- setNames(lab_map$short_label, disp$KO)
ko_italic <- setNames(toupper(lab_map$italic) == "TRUE", disp$KO)
ko_axis_labels <- function(breaks) do.call(expression, lapply(breaks, function(b)
  if (isTRUE(ko_italic[[b]])) bquote(italic(.(ko_short[[b]]))) else ko_short[[b]]))
# Label table for Data 1 (S51): display decisions joined to the full KO annotation of f3_display.tsv.
rwv_write_tsv(data.frame(KO = disp$KO, display_order = disp$display_order, selection = disp$selection,
                         short_label = lab_map$short_label, label_type = lab_map$label_type, italic = lab_map$italic,
                         annotation_full = disp$label_full, basis = lab_map$basis),
              path_target("f3_ko_labels.tsv"))
heat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lvl, function(s) data.frame(row_label = disp$row_label, KO = disp$KO, sample_id = s,
                                                            tpm = as.numeric(disp[[s]]))))
heat$row_label <- factor(heat$row_label, levels = row_levels)
heat$sample_id <- factor(heat$sample_id, levels = lvl)
heat$value <- log10(heat$tpm + 1)
rwv_check(checks, "row totals reproduce total_TPM", as.numeric(disp$total_TPM),
          unname(tapply(heat$tpm, heat$KO, sum)[disp$KO]), tol = 1e-6, source = "amg_ko_matrix_tpm.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "no non-zero cell below 1 TPM (zero cells cannot be confused with the lowest colour)", 0,
          sum(heat$tpm > 0 & heat$tpm < 1))
```

### Task 3: Panel b: carrier-rank contributions in matching row order

Colours indicate rank within each row (Top 1/2/3/remaining), not the same vOTU across rows.

```{r}
#| label: panel-b
ranks$row_label <- factor(disp$row_label[match(ranks$KO, disp$KO)], levels = row_levels)
ranks$rank_class <- factor(ranks$rank_class, levels = rev(names(palettes$carrier_rank)))
top1 <- ranks[ranks$rank_class == "Top 1", ]
lab <- data.frame(row_label = factor(disp$row_label, levels = row_levels),
                  txt = sprintf("n = %s; %s (%.0f%%)", rwv_fmt_int(as.numeric(disp$n_carriers)), top1$vOTU_id[match(disp$KO, top1$KO)],
                                100 * top1$fraction[match(disp$KO, top1$KO)]))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "k00558_carriers", as.numeric(disp$n_carriers[disp$KO == "K00558"]), "f3_display.tsv")
```

### Task 4: Panel c: separate defense/anti-defense tools and units

```{r}
#| label: panel-c
n_of <- function(x) sets$n[sets$set == x]
narp_n <- c(NARP1 = sum(narp$df_narp1 == "1"), NARP2 = sum(narp$df_narp2 == "1"))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "df_antidefense", n_of("DefenseFinder anti-defense"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "dbapis_filtered", n_of("filtered dbAPIS"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "antidefense_overlap", n_of("DefenseFinder anti-defense AND dbAPIS"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "antidefense_union", n_of("Anti-defense union (OR)"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "df_defense", n_of("DefenseFinder defense"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "padloc", n_of("PADLOC defense"), "defense_sets.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp1_df", unname(narp_n["NARP1"]), "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp2_df", unname(narp_n["NARP2"]), "narp_definitions.tsv")
bars <- data.frame(
  group = c(rep("Anti-defense candidates", 4), rep("Candidate defense-related calls", 2), rep("NARP calls (anti-defense subset)", 2)),
  set = c("DefenseFinder anti-defense", "filtered dbAPIS", "Both (overlap)", "Union: DefenseFinder or dbAPIS",
          "DefenseFinder defense", "PADLOC", "NARP1", "NARP2"),
  n = c(n_of("DefenseFinder anti-defense"), n_of("filtered dbAPIS"), n_of("DefenseFinder anti-defense AND dbAPIS"),
        n_of("Anti-defense union (OR)"), n_of("DefenseFinder defense"), n_of("PADLOC defense"), narp_n),
  kind = c("tool", "tool", "set operation", "set operation", "tool", "tool", "tool", "tool"))
bars$set <- factor(bars$set, levels = rev(bars$set))
bars$group <- factor(bars$group, levels = unique(bars$group))
bars$txt <- rwv_fmt_int(bars$n)   # v50: the common denominator 3,060 is stated once, on the axis title
bars$fill_key <- ifelse(bars$group == "Anti-defense candidates",
                        ifelse(bars$kind == "tool", "anti_defense_tool", "anti_defense_derived"),
                        ifelse(grepl("^NARP", as.character(bars$set)), "narp_call", "defense_tool"))
```

### Task 5: Panel d: ORF101-ORF103 on vOTU0052

Plot only the real ORF101-ORF103 coordinates, all on the positive strand. ORF166 (atd1, 91,206-91,499 bp) is a separate system call about 45 kb away and is excluded from this neighbourhood.

```{r}
#| label: panel-d
locus$start <- as.numeric(locus$start_position); locus$end <- as.numeric(locus$end_position)
locus <- locus[order(as.numeric(locus$gene_position)), ]
c52 <- catalogue[catalogue$vOTU_id == "vOTU0052", ]
rwv_check(checks, "vOTU0052 CheckV values in subtitle", c("132528", "Medium-quality", "88.84"),
          c(c52$contig_length_bp, c52$checkv_quality, c52$checkv_completeness_pct), source = "checkv_catalogue.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "vOTU0052 is one of the DefenseFinder NARP2 calls", "1", narp$df_narp2[narp$vOTU_id == "vOTU0052"],
          source = "narp_definitions.tsv")
arrow_poly <- function(s, e, y, h = 0.32, head = 180) {
  hs <- max(s, e - head)
  data.frame(x = c(s, hs, e, hs, s), y = c(y - h, y - h, y, y + h, y + h))
}
polys <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(locus)), function(i) cbind(arrow_poly(locus$start[i], locus$end[i], 1), id = locus$gene_position[i])))
polys$role <- ifelse(polys$id == "102", "candidate", "narp_member")
lab_top <- c(`101` = "ORF101", `102` = "ORF102", `103` = "ORF103")
lab_bottom <- c(`101` = "nadM/NMNAT (K13522)", `102` = "GIY-YIG/NUMOD-like\ncandidate", `103` = "NAMPT (K03462)")
locus$mid <- (locus$start + locus$end) / 2
locus$lab1 <- unname(lab_top[locus$gene_position])
locus$lab2 <- unname(lab_bottom[locus$gene_position])
rwv_check(checks, "labels matched to ORFs by position number", c("ORF101", "ORF102", "ORF103"), locus$lab1)
# Contig overview (2026-10-11): the whole vOTU0052 sequence drawn above the gene
# map on the same x range (rescaled, so it carries its own end labels), with the
# displayed window marked and joined to the map by two guide lines.
ctg_len <- as.numeric(c52$contig_length_bp)
ov_x <- function(p) 42450 + p / ctg_len * (46150 - 42450)
win <- c(min(locus$start), max(locus$end))
rwv_check(checks, "overview window equals the ORF101-ORF103 span (bp)", c(42702, 45891), win, source = "votu0052_locus.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "overview window lies inside the contig", TRUE, win[1] >= 1 && win[2] <= ctg_len, source = "checkv_catalogue.tsv")
```

### Task 6: Assemble and export

```{r}
#| label: assemble
# 2026-10-18 (v38): adopted panel-consult version D (outputs/fig345-visual-review-2026-10-17, code/final-figure3.R),
# with the author-approved follow-up: more space between the nadM note and panel c (page 230 -> 234 mm).
# The page is drawn with grid at absolute mm positions on the full W x H page and handed to rwv_figure_export
# as one patchwork element inside a W x H viewport, so the symmetric export margin leaves the positions unchanged.
W <- spec$width_mm; H <- spec$height_mm; P <- pt; rule <- col$grey_rule
lw <- function(mm) mm / 25.4 * 96   # grid lwd from the style line widths (1 lwd = 1/96 in)
rwv_check(checks, "page size of the adopted layout (mm)", c(180, 234), c(W, H), source = "config/figures.yml")
reds <- grDevices::hcl.colors(palettes$heatmap$levels, "Reds", rev = TRUE)
rlevels <- c("Top 1", "Top 2", "Top 3", "Other carriers"); rcols <- unlist(palettes$carrier_rank)[rlevels]
sites <- as.character(samples$site)
rwv_check(checks, "site strip order", c(rep("Beijing", 3), rep("Garching", 2), rep("Oberschleissheim", 2)), sites)
rwv_check(checks, "heatmap values lie on the 0-6 colour scale", TRUE, max(heat$value) <= 6)
rwv_check(checks, "tool panel rows in drawing order", c("DefenseFinder anti-defense", "filtered dbAPIS", "Both (overlap)",
          "Union: DefenseFinder or dbAPIS", "DefenseFinder defense", "PADLOC", "NARP1", "NARP2"), as.character(bars$set))
nadm_rank <- as.numeric(disp$rank_total_TPM[disp$KO == "K13522"])
q_abbr <- c("Complete" = "complete", "High-quality" = "HQ", "Medium-quality" = "MQ", "Low-quality" = "LQ")
c52_lab <- sprintf("%s bp; CheckV %s; %s%% estimated completeness", rwv_fmt_int(ctg_len), q_abbr[[c52$checkv_quality]],
                   c52$checkv_completeness_pct)
ctg_end <- sprintf("%s kb", formatC(ctg_len / 1000, format = "f", digits = 1))
tx <- function(s, x, y, size = P$annotation, just = "left", face = "plain", colour = ink)
  grid::grid.text(s, unit(x, "mm"), unit(H - y, "mm"), just = just, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = fam, fontsize = size, fontface = face, col = colour))
box <- function(x, y, w, h, fill, colour = NA)
  grid::grid.rect(unit(x, "mm"), unit(H - y, "mm"), unit(w, "mm"), unit(h, "mm"), gp = grid::gpar(fill = fill, col = colour, lwd = lw(style$line_mm$hairline)))
ln <- function(x, y, xx, yy, colour = rule, lwd = lw(style$line_mm$thin), lty = 1)
  grid::grid.lines(unit(c(x, xx), "mm"), unit(H - c(y, yy), "mm"), gp = grid::gpar(col = colour, lwd = lwd, lty = lty))
# v50 figure cleanup (2026-10-19, Codex task book docs/figure-cleanup-v49-2026-10-19/00): panel letters only; no
# explanatory panel titles, footnote sentences or contig-metadata line (meaning carried by the caption and the
# Supplementary figure notes). Rows, values, order and encodings unchanged; page size unchanged (config/figures.yml).
tag <- function(lab, y, x = 5) tx(rwv_tag(style, lab), x, y, P$tag, face = "bold")
draw_ko <- function() {
  tag("A", 7); tag("B", 7, 98)
  tx("KO / function", 43, 14, just = "right", face = "bold"); tx("Carrier abundance", 71, 14, just = "centre", face = "bold")
  tx("Within-KO\nTPM share (%)", 115, 14, just = "centre", face = "bold"); tx("Carriers\n(n)", 140, 14, just = "centre", face = "bold")
  tx("Top carrier", 162, 14, just = "centre", face = "bold")
  x0 <- 50; cw <- 6.7
  for (j in 1:7) { x <- x0 + (j - 1) * cw; tx(lvl[j], x, 21, just = "centre"); box(x, 24, cw - .25, .8, site_col[[sites[j]]]) }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(disp))) {
    y <- 30 + (i - 1) * 4.6
    if (i %% 2 == 0) box(90, y, 170, 4.6, "#FAFAFA")
    tx(lab_map$short_label[i], 43, y, just = "right", face = if (toupper(lab_map$italic[i]) == "TRUE") "italic" else "plain")
    if (disp$KO[i] == "K13522") tx("†", 43.6, y - .6)   # prespecified NARP case; explained in the caption
    for (j in 1:7) {
      x <- x0 + (j - 1) * cw; v <- as.numeric(disp[[lvl[j]]][i])
      box(x, y, cw - .25, 4.0, if (v > 0) reds[1 + round(255 * log10(v + 1) / 6)] else palettes$heatmap$zero, rule)
    }
    z <- ranks[ranks$KO == disp$KO[i], ]; z <- z[match(rlevels, as.character(z$rank_class)), ]; start <- 100
    for (j in 1:4) { w <- 31 * z$fraction[j]; if (w > 0) box(start + w / 2, y, w, 3.8, rcols[j]); start <- start + w }
    tx(disp$n_carriers[i], 140, y, just = "centre"); tx(z$vOTU_id[1], 149, y); tx(paste0(round(100 * z$fraction[1]), "%"), 175, y, just = "right")
    if (i == 10) ln(5, y + 2.3, 175, y + 2.3, ink, lw(style$line_mm$main), 2)
  }
  tx("log10(summed carrier TPM + 1)", 49, 86)
  for (k in 1:256) box(49 + 36 * (k - .5) / 256, 90, 36 / 256 + .03, 2.2, reds[k])
  for (v in c(0, 2, 4, 6)) tx(v, 49 + 36 * v / 6, 94, just = "centre")
  for (j in 1:4) { x <- 101 + (j - 1) * 18; box(x, 90, 3, 3, rcols[j]); tx(c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "Other")[j], x + 2.2, 90) }
  box(7, 90, 2.6, 2.6, palettes$heatmap$zero, rule); tx("0 TPM", 10, 90)
  for (v in c(0, 50, 100)) tx(v, 100 + 31 * v / 100, 84, just = "centre")
}
draw_tools <- function(c0 = 104) {
  tag("C", c0)
  x0 <- 67; ww <- 88; scale <- ww / 800
  labs <- c("DefenseFinder anti-defense", "Filtered dbAPIS", "Both (overlap)", "Union: DefenseFinder or dbAPIS",
            "DefenseFinder defense", "PADLOC", "NARP1", "NARP2")
  yy <- c0 + c(11, 16, 21, 26, 37, 42, 53, 58)
  fills <- unlist(palettes$function_calls)[bars$fill_key]
  tx("Anti-defense", x0, c0 + 6, face = "bold"); tx("Defense", x0, c0 + 32, face = "bold")
  tx("NARP (anti-defense subsets)", x0, c0 + 48, face = "bold")
  for (i in 1:8) {
    tx(labs[i], x0 - 2, yy[i], just = "right"); box(x0 + bars$n[i] * scale / 2, yy[i], bars$n[i] * scale, 3.1, fills[i], ink)
    tx(bars$txt[i], x0 + bars$n[i] * scale + 1, yy[i])
  }
  ya <- c0 + 61
  ln(x0, ya, x0 + ww, ya, ink, lw(style$line_mm$main))
  for (v in seq(0, 800, 200)) { ln(x0 + v * scale, ya, x0 + v * scale, ya + 1, ink, lw(style$line_mm$main)); tx(v, x0 + v * scale, ya + 4, just = "centre") }
  tx("vOTUs (of 3,060)", x0 + ww / 2, ya + 9, just = "centre")
}
draw_locus <- function(y = 179) {
  tag("D", y)
  tx("vOTU0052 (+ strand)", 12, y, face = "bold")
  box(130, y, 3, 3, palettes$gene$narp_member, ink); tx("Candidate NARP2 member", 133, y)
  ln(7, y + 8, 173, y + 8, col$grey_mid, lw(style$line_mm$main))
  xa <- 7 + 166 * win[1] / ctg_len; xb <- 7 + 166 * win[2] / ctg_len; box((xa + xb) / 2, y + 8, xb - xa, 2, "white", ink)
  tx("0", 7, y + 12); tx(ctg_end, 173, y + 12, just = "right")
  xf <- function(v) 8 + (v - 42500) / 3500 * 165
  ln(8, y + 28, 173, y + 28, col$grey_mid, lw(style$line_mm$main))
  for (i in 1:3) {
    x <- xf(locus$start[i]); xx <- xf(locus$end[i]); head <- min(3.5, (xx - x) * .3)
    grid::grid.polygon(unit(c(x, xx - head, xx, xx - head, x), "mm"), unit(H - c(y + 25, y + 25, y + 28, y + 31, y + 31), "mm"),
                       gp = grid::gpar(fill = if (i == 2) "white" else palettes$gene$narp_member, col = ink, lwd = lw(if (i == 2) style$line_mm$emphasis else style$line_mm$thin)))
    tx(locus$lab1[i], (x + xx) / 2, y + 20, just = "centre", face = "bold")
    if (i == 1) {   # v44: only nadM italic; NMNAT and the KO number upright
      tx(expression(italic(nadM) * " / NMNAT"), (x + xx) / 2, y + 33.05, just = "centre")
      tx("(K13522)", (x + xx) / 2, y + 36.95, just = "centre")
    } else tx(c("", "GIY-YIG / NUMOD-like\ncandidate", "NAMPT\n(K03462)")[i], (x + xx) / 2, y + 35, just = "centre")
  }
  ln(8, y + 40, 173, y + 40, ink, lw(style$line_mm$main))
  for (v in seq(42500, 46000, 500)) { x <- xf(v); ln(x, y + 40, x, y + 41, ink, lw(style$line_mm$main)); tx(sprintf("%.1f", v / 1000), x, y + 44, just = "centre") }
  tx("Position on recovered sequence (kb)", 90, y + 49, just = "centre")
}
page <- grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(rwv_capture_grob({ draw_ko(); draw_tools(); draw_locus() },
                                                                  width = rwv_mm_to_in(W), height = rwv_mm_to_in(H), style = style, fonts = fonts)),
                    vp = grid::viewport(width = unit(W, "mm"), height = unit(H, "mm"), clip = "off"))
fig <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = page)
expected_text <- c(rwv_tag(style, c("A", "B", "C", "D")), lvl, "KO / function", "Carrier abundance",
                   "log10(summed carrier TPM + 1)", "0 TPM", "Within-KO", "TPM share (%)", "Carriers", "(n)", "Top carrier",
                   "vOTUs (of 3,060)", "Position on recovered sequence (kb)", "vOTU0052 (+ strand)", "Candidate NARP2 member",
                   "Anti-defense", "Defense", "NARP (anti-defense subsets)", lab_map$short_label, "\u2020", "ORF102",
                   "722", "106", "715", "99", "vOTU2575", ctg_end)
res <- rwv_figure_export(fig, path_target, "fig3", spec, style, fonts, expected_text, step)
knitr::kable(res$qa[, c("format", "check", "observed", "pass")])
```
